from collections import Counter
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    # find separator column: uniform across rows, color != overall background
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cand=[c for c in range(W) if len(set(r[c] for r in I))==1 and r[c]!=bg for r in I]
    if not cand: cand=[max(c for c in range(W) if len(set(r[c] for r in I))==1)]
    s=max(cand)
    bgL=Counter(I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(s)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bgR=Counter(I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(s+1,W)).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nl=Counter(I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(s) if I[i][j] not in (bg,bgL)).most_common()
    nr=Counter(I[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(s+1,W) if I[i][j]!=bgR).most_common()
    nls={k:v for k,v in nl}; nrs={k:v for k,v in nr}
    common=set(nls)&set(nrs)
    fill=nls & nrs
    fill=sorted(common&{k for k in nl}) and next(iter(common)) or max(largest(k) for k in (nl,nr))
    # simpler: most common color appearing in both halves' noise
    inter=list(common)
    fill=inter[0] if inter else nl.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[]

        ls={j for j in range(s) if I[i][j] not in (bg,bgL)}
        rs={j-s-1 for j in range(s+1,W) if I[i][j]!=bgR}
